title: fix(desktop): integrate the top bar on Windows via titleBarOverlay
author: devin-ai-integration
head: 178f9d13522153d0d829c48490d4c7ba42a138af
body:
## Change

The integrated 40px top strip shipped tuned for macOS (`hiddenInset` + traffic lights). On Windows the window still used `titleBarStyle: "default"`, so a native caption bar **and** the native menu bar stacked on top of the web strip — three rows of chrome.

- `desktop/lib/windows.mjs`: win32 main window → `titleBarStyle: "hidden"` + `titleBarOverlay { height: 40, color: "#00000000", symbolColor: "#90909d" }` (Electron's Window Controls Overlay paints min/max/close inside the same 40px row) + `autoHideMenuBar: true` (menu hidden; accelerators keep working — note: bare Alt does not reveal the menu on frameless windows, a known Electron limitation, electron#9990). macOS (`hiddenInset`, `TRAFFIC_LIGHT_POSITION`) is byte-identical; Linux keeps the native `default` frame (scoped out per review — overlay is unverified there); the settings dialog keeps its native caption.
- `ui/src/App.tsx` + `desktopShell.ts`: `isWindowsDesktop()` off the existing bridge platform, tagging `.app` with `app--windows` (mirrors `app--macos`).
- `top-strip.css`: new `--wc-inset` (`calc(138px / var(--chrome-zoom, 1))`) reserves the right edge for the overlay buttons — zoom-aware like `--tl-inset` since the overlay doesn't zoom. `.panel-top` clears it, the collapsed horizontal history strip clears it, and `app--settings-open` keeps `.panel-top` mounted on Windows as the drag surface under the overlay (it stays `aria-hidden` when it has no button).
- `SidebarTopStrip.tsx`: `.panel-top` renders on win32 even without a panel toggle, purely as the overlay's drag surface.
- `desktop/pages/loading.*`: the `.drag` strip is no longer darwin-only — win32 shows it too, with a 140px right margin clearing the overlay while the server boots. Linux unchanged (native frame).
- Browser strip fixes found in a plain-Chrome audit of `dev`:
  - collapsed sidebar + sidebar-less modes (home/agent/assets/asset-gen): workspaces pinned `grid-column: 2` while the grid collapsed to one column → dead left band; now `grid-column: 1 / -1` under `app--nav-collapsed`, same pattern as the existing settings rule.
  - node canvas + `app--rp-collapsed`: the floating `.panel-top` toggle covered the toolbar's rightmost button; the toolbar gets the same `--wc-inset`-aware clearance the horizontal history strip already had.
- `tests/desktop-titlebar-contract.test.ts`: pins the Windows path (hidden style gated to `win32`, overlay height == `--chrome-top-h`, `--wc-inset` ≥ 138px, panel-top drag surface, collapsed-workspace span, node-toolbar clearance, no Linux drag strip). All existing macOS/served-IPC assertions untouched.
- Browser sessions: no bridge → no `app--windows`, no insets, unchanged rendering.

![after-max](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..0FXIsZuAB5qrlEcaWbHLh4PLkiGZr0nYkCR-nknJGyA)

## Checks

- [x] `npm run typecheck` + `typecheck:tests`
- [x] `npm test` — run on Windows against dev: 3742/3832 pass; the 63 failures are pre-existing Windows fs/spawn-semantics and Node-24.0.1 stderr issues on dev, unrelated to this diff (`tests/desktop-titlebar-contract.test.ts` itself passes 6/6).
- [x] `cd ui && npm run build` (if `ui/` changed)
- [x] Electron 44 launched on Windows Server 2022: single top row, overlay min/max/close verified (maximize + restore), sidebar collapse + right-panel toggle work, no menu-bar row. Playwright e2e not run — the suite is gated to disposable GitHub Linux runners (`assertJ6Isolation`) by design; CI's ubuntu `e2e` job covers it.
- Note: `npm ci` on this box needs Node ≥22 (engines); `C:\hostedtoolcache\node\24.0.1\x64` works, default Node 20 fails node-gyp.

Do not publish, change dist-tags, or dispatch release workflows from this PR.

adjudication.reason:
This check verifies the core requirements of PR #331 which integrates the top bar on Windows via titleBarOverlay. It checks:

1. **desktop/lib/windows.mjs**: win32 uses `titleBarStyle: "hidden"` (not `"default"`) with `titleBarOverlay` containing height: 40, color: "#00000000", symbolColor: "#90909d", plus `autoHideMenuBar: true`
2. **ui/src/lib/desktopShell.ts**: exports `isWindowsDesktop()` that checks for win32 platform
3. **ui/src/App.tsx**: uses `isWindowsDesktop()` to add `app--windows` class
4. **ui/src/styles/top-strip.css**: has `--wc-inset` CSS variable and `.app--windows { --wc-inset: calc(138px / var(--chrome-zoom, 1)); }`
5. **desktop/pages/loading.js**: sets `data-platform` attribute from bridge platform
6. **desktop/pages/loading.css**: shows `.drag` strip on both darwin and win32
7. **ui/src/components/SidebarTopStrip.tsx**: renders panel-top on Windows even without a panel toggle

Before the PR, Windows would have used `titleBarStyle: "default"` (native caption bar) with no overlay, no `isWindowsDesktop()` function, no `app--windows` class, no `--wc-inset`, and the drag strip would be darwin-only. All these checks would fail on the pre-PR code.
adjudication.requirement: The PR integrates the top bar on Windows via titleBarOverlay, replacing the native caption bar with Electron's Window Controls Overlay painted into the same 40px row as the web UI's title strip. This requires: win32 windows to use titleBarStyle: "hidden" + titleBarOverlay config; isWindowsDesktop() bridge function; app--windows CSS class; --wc-inset CSS variable for overlay clearance; drag strip on loading page for both darwin and win32; SidebarTopStrip rendering panel-top on Windows as drag surface.
